sphere_commentary.overview:
The three series show consistent positive outcomes with HEALING leading in mean score and consistency, THRIVING close behind, and TRANSFORMING showing greater variability.
• HEALING has the highest mean (6.98) and lowest std (1.77), reflecting its regulation focus.
• THRIVING matches HEALING in mean (6.96) with similar std (1.72), indicating cognitive optimisation.
• TRANSFORMING has the lowest mean (6.59) and highest std (1.87), consistent with its ascending-arc design for low-affect states.
sphere_commentary.cross_series:
Each series reflects its design intent in response patterns.
• HEALING shows consistent, moderate-high scores with low variance, indicating reliable nervous-system regulation.
• THRIVING matches HEALING in mean but with stronger signals in Hold-type protocols (Focus & Clarity, Creative Flow) for cognitive engagement.
• TRANSFORMING displays greater variability, especially in Ascents, reflecting the challenge of entraining low-affect states.
sphere_commentary.anomalies:
Several protocols show anomalous patterns requiring investigation.
• X-MC-L3 (mean=5.7, std=2.45) — lowest score and highest dispersion, suggesting population mismatch or design flaw.
• X-MD-L1 and X-MD-L2 show weaker outcomes in Motivation & Drive ascents (per one analyzer), warranting further investigation.
• Note: These anomalies may indicate subgroup effects or design limitations needing protocol-level review.
sphere_commentary.development_signals:
Development signals suggest protocol refinements and outreach efforts.
• X-MC-L3 (n=10) – high std – consider L2 variant with adjusted Hz ramps or extended hold phase [multiple analyzers].
• X-MD-L3 (n=13) – heterogeneous response – investigate population split via adviser/unknown or implement responder pre-screen [multiple analyzers].
• H-OS-L1 (n=95, views=30) – strong outcomes but low reach – boost platform promotion to increase discovery [per two analyzers, actions differ].
• T-FC-L3 (n=35, mean=7.63) – top focus performer – prototype L2/L3 variants to capitalize on gains [single source].
sphere_commentary.embedding_analysis:
Embedding context indicates evolving analytical patterns over time.
• CROSS‑RUN DRIFT: 27 of 30 protocols show similarity <0.85, with several below 0.70, suggesting substantive changes in listener response or recording style.
• CROSS‑PROTOCOL SEMANTIC CLUSTERS: insufficient embeddings for robust clustering; protocols remain analytically isolated.
• Confidence note: drift metrics are based on limited historical data; interpret as indicative, not definitive.
